inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2026E owner FCF of $10,492m, from reported H1-2026 FCF of $5,078m (OCF 5,213 less capex 135) grown by FY2025's own H2/H1 ratio of 1.07x. NOT the $9,763m FY2025 base the prior model used. H1 FCF grew 7.5% YoY (4,725 -> 5,078); the model's 18% Year-1 assumption needed H2 to run 1.27x H1 when last year it ran 1.07x.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: GAAP EPS and net income are unreliable for growth rate selection due to a ~$6.4B one-time deferred-tax-valuation-allowance release recognized in FY2024, which inflated FY2024 net income to $9.86B and makes FY2024-FY2025 NI comparisons meaningless on a GAAP basis. Additionally, equity investment mark-to-market swings (e.g., Q4 2025 net income of only $296M on $1.77B operating income) introduce persistent P&L noise. This model is therefore FULLY FCF-BASED. Base-year FCF anchored to FY2025 actual FCF of $9,763M (TTM FCF through Q1 2026 is ~$9,799M, essentially identical). FCF 1-year growth of 42% is exceptional and driven partly by operating leverage maturation; it is not used as a projection base rate. Instead, growth rates are anchored to the revenue 3-year CAGR of ~17.7% (consistent with Q2 2026 guidance of 18-22% constant-currency gross bookings growth) and decelerate conservatively. Net debt corrected from prior model: Q1 2026 Total Debt $10,514M minus Cash $5,558M = $4,956M net debt (prior model incorrectly showed negative net debt).

base.rationale: FCF growth tracks slightly above revenue growth (18% Year 1) reflecting ongoing operating leverage from a mature platform, then decelerates toward a mid-teens rate consistent with global ride-hailing/delivery market growth. Revenue 3yr CAGR is 17.7%; Q2 2026 guidance implies 18-22% constant-currency bookings growth. WACC of 10% reflects modest risk premium for a profitable but still-expanding platform with regulatory exposure.

bull.rationale: AV platform (Uber Autonomous Solutions, 12+ partners, 15 city deployments targeted FY2026) generates incremental high-margin platform fees. Uber One (36M members, 60% YoY) deepens monetization and retention. Advertising revenue scales. $20B buyback accelerates per-share value creation. FCF margin expands as driver incentive costs fall proportionally with AV mix. Lower WACC of 9% reflects accelerating FCF generation and reduced uncertainty.

bear.rationale: Waymo and other AV operators build direct consumer apps at scale, bypassing Uber's marketplace. DoorDash-Lyft bundle gains material delivery share from Uber Eats. Gig worker reclassification in a major jurisdiction raises labor cost structure. Macro slowdown compresses consumer discretionary spending. Higher WACC of 11.5% reflects regulatory, competitive, and macro execution risk materializing simultaneously.

fields_updated: full model rebuild on Q2-2026 actuals

valuation_philosophy: Rebuilt 2026-08-28 on Q2-2026, which the prior 2026-06-30 model predates. The thesis SURVIVES: income from operations rose 30% in Q2 and 42% in H1, and FCF conversion is intact (H1 capex only $135m on $5,213m OCF). What changes is magnitude -- Year-1 FCF growth of 18% is not supported by H1's 7.5%, so the base rebases to +16% weighted upside from +44%. Two things the prior model could not see: net income is contaminated by equity revaluation (Q2 'other income' of +1,342 includes +1,618 of equity gains, of which ~$1.1bn is a one-off Delivery Hero remeasurement; H1 other income is NEGATIVE 152 despite that) so operating income is the earnings signal, not net income; and the pending Delivery Hero takeover at EUR41.50/share (~$14.8bn, EUR14.2bn bridge facility, closing 2H-2027) is a step-change in capital structure. Debt has already risen 10,521 -> 12,723 and cash fallen 7,105 -> 4,870. The bear case carries that leverage risk.

sanity_check_verdict.reason: Weighted IV $89.34 vs price $76.95 (+16.1%), rebuilt on Q2-2026 actuals.
sanity_check_verdict.value_investor_conclusion: Still the best risk-adjusted large-cap on this screen at +16% weighted. The Delivery Hero bridge facility is the thing to watch: it converts a net-cash-ish balance sheet into a levered one before the deal closes in 2H-2027.
